meta.title: Rental agreement
meta.description: Read and e-sign your rental agreement, and confirm the vehicle check at handover and return.

lookup.title: Open your rental agreement
lookup.lede: Enter your reference. It starts with LR- and is in your confirmation message.
lookup.label: Reference
lookup.notFound: We couldn't find {ref} on this device. Open the link on the device you used to send the request.

pending.title: Your agreement opens once we confirm your request
pending.text: We check the car and your documents first. When we confirm, the rental agreement for the {car} appears here for you to read and sign. You can also sign it at handover.
pending.closedText: This request is {status}, so there is no rental agreement to sign.

doc.title: Rental agreement
doc.intro: This agreement is between the owner and the hirer named below, for the car and dates shown. It includes our {terms} in the version shown above. Times are Dubai time.

charges.title: Charges
charges.lede: Prices are in AED and include 5% VAT. The deposit is a refundable hold on your card, not a payment.
charges.ledeChauffeur: Prices are in AED and include 5% VAT.
charges.depositValue: {amount}, a refundable hold on the main driver's credit card at handover. Released {days} days after return, less any fines, tolls or charges.
charges.fullCoverChosen: Chosen, {perDay} per day. Excess {excess} per claim; tyres, rims and glass covered.
charges.fullCoverNot: Not chosen. Available at {perDay} per day, which lowers the excess to {excess}.

fees.title: Fees during the rental
fees.lede: Charged after the rental, as set out in the Terms of Rental.
fees.salikValue: AED {peak} per crossing at peak times, AED {offPeak} at other times, free {free}. Plus AED {admin} admin per crossing.
fees.darbValue: AED {peak} per crossing at peak times, free at other times. Plus AED {admin} admin per crossing.
fees.fuelValue: Return the car with the same fuel level. If it is lower, fuel at pump price plus {fee}.
fees.finesValue: The fine plus {fee} admin per fine. Black points are transferred to the driver's licence where the authority allows.
fees.lateValue: Free up to {grace} minutes late. After that, {pct}% of the daily rate per started hour, up to one extra day.
fees.overtimeValue: {rate} per hour, billed per started {step} minutes.

terms.title: Key terms
terms.lede: A short summary. The full terms are in our {terms} and form part of this agreement.
terms.uae: Drive within the UAE only. Crossing into Oman or any other country, off-road or sand driving, track use, ride-hailing and commercial filming need our written approval.
terms.drivers: Only drivers named on this agreement may drive: aged {age} or older, with a full licence held for at least {years} years. Driving by anyone else voids the insurance.
terms.accident: Report any accident or damage to the police (Dubai Police app or 999) and to us straight away. Without a police report you pay the full repair cost.
terms.exclusions: No insurance applies to driving under the influence, unnamed drivers, racing, off-road driving or taking the car outside the UAE.
terms.damage: Damage is charged from an agency-garage estimate, capped at the excess when the insurance applies. Loss of use is {pct}% of the daily rate, for up to {days} days.
terms.chauffeur: Our chauffeur drives the car for the whole booking. Up to {max} passengers, or fewer if the car has fewer seats.
terms.care: No smoking, vaping or pets in the car (assistance animals are welcome). Cleaning or odour treatment costs {fee}.
terms.deposit: We release the deposit hold {days} days after return, less any fines, tolls or charges. Your bank may take a further {bank} working days.
terms.law: This agreement is governed by the laws of the Emirate of Dubai and the federal laws of the UAE.

sign.title: Signatures
sign.lede: Read the agreement, then sign as the main driver. You can also sign at handover.
sign.ledeChauffeur: Read the agreement, then sign as the customer. You can also sign at handover.
sign.name: Full name
sign.nameHint: As it appears on your passport or driving licence.
sign.terms: I accept the {terms} and the key terms above.
sign.deposit: I agree to the deposit hold of {amount} on my card at handover.
sign.depositNone: I understand that no deposit is held for chauffeur bookings.
sign.damage: I accept the excess of {amount} per claim and the damage terms.
sign.damageFullCover: I accept the damage terms. With Full Cover the excess is {amount} per claim.
sign.damageChauffeur: I accept the damage and cleaning terms.
sign.record: We record your typed name, your signature and the time with this agreement.
sign.notOpen: This booking is {status}, so the agreement can no longer be signed.
